subject: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Suneeta Rao <suneeta@acmetech.io>, Alex Morgan <alex@acmetech.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech

Hi Suneeta / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it’s fresh: 

Summary of what we agreed:
- Redwood will run a 3-week trial (hosted) focused on two features: customer support summarization and in-product contextual search.
- Success criteria: summarization ROUGE/precision targets + search recall on a 1k prompt set; latency SLO = p95 < 450ms; cost target ~ $0.005/token (pilot).
- Data: Acme will provide a ~10k sample of support tickets and a subset of production search queries (anonymized).

New ask from your side during the call:
- Add one exploratory integration: a Slack-based triage workflow where summaries are pushed into a triage channel for CS. You flagged this as potentially high value but exploratory.

Proposal to keep trial scoped and measurable:
1) Turn Slack triage into an "exploratory use case" (not blocking core POC acceptance). We suggest adding it mid-trial in week 2 if the summarization baseline is stable.
2) Update the evaluation plan to include an "exploratory signal" for triage (CS triage click-through and triage time saved) — tracked qualitatively and with a short survey.
3) Update owners and timelines below.

Proposed updated timeline (subject to your sign-off):
- Week 0 (now): Data handoff + access setup (Acme -> Redwood).
- Week 1: Baseline runs for summarization & search; initial metric capture.
- Week 2: Integration spike for Slack triage (optional) + A/B probe for summaries.
- Week 3: Final evaluation, acceptance review, handoff for production readiness.

Owners:
- Redwood: Vanessa (PM) + Rishi (SRE/SE) => implementation + metric capture.
- Acme: Suneeta (Product lead) + Alex (Engineering) => data & integration support.

Attachments: I’m attaching a draft POC matrix and an updated plan PDF for your review (Acme_POC_Matrix.xlsx, redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf).

Action items / asks for Acme:
- Please confirm you’re ok with Slack triage being exploratory and added week 2 if we have stability.
- Share anonymized sample dataset and a lead contact for infra access (staging token/whitelist IPs).
- Confirm legal/procurement cadence if this expands beyond hosted trial.

I’ll wait for your confirmation and will loop in Soojin from Solutions if you want an integration scoping call.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachment: Acme_POC_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Suneeta Rao <suneeta@acmetech.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@acmetech.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech

Thanks Vanessa — this is a great write-up. A couple of clarifications and one request from our side: 

1) Slack triage: happy with the exploratory approach. We do want to see a short integration spike in week 2; if it shows clear signal we'll fast-track.

2) Additional use case: our Head of Ops asked whether Redwood can also score "escalation urgency" on tickets (low/medium/high) as part of the summarization output. It can be a simple classifier on the summary, does not need perfect accuracy but should be included in the POC matrix.

3) Data: we can share an anonymized 12k-ticket dump + search logs by end of day Wednesday. I’ll route procurement for the standard DPA and any firewall whitelist.

Could you add the urgency classifier to the POC matrix and propose a lightweight acceptance threshold? Also please include a short list of integration tasks if we decide to push Slack triage forward.

— Suneeta
Suneeta Rao
Director, Product — Support & Insights | AcmeTech
suneeta@acmetech.io

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Suneeta Rao <suneeta@acmetech.io>, Alex Morgan <alex@acmetech.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech

Appreciate the fast follow, Suneeta.

We can add the urgency classifier as an additional signal: proposed approach below — I’ve attached an updated matrix that includes acceptance thresholds and a short Slack integration checklist.

Urgency classifier (proposed):
- Output: {low|medium|high} appended to the summary payload.
- Acceptance threshold: precision >= 0.65 and recall >= 0.6 on a 300-sample labeled set (we can jointly label 150 samples each).
- Metric capture: confusion matrix + a small human review sample in week 3.

Slack triage integration checklist (short):
- Webhook endpoint + auth token (Acme provides).
- Mapping: summary payload -> Slack message template.
- Fallback: if inference latency > 800ms, send plain link to ticket instead.
- CS survey link insertion (for qualitative signal).

I updated redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (attached) and added the urgency rows to Acme_POC_Matrix.xlsx. If these thresholds look reasonable, we’ll proceed to instrument the evaluation harness and label set.

Next steps I’ll take this evening:
- Create a shared labeling doc and assign 150 samples to Redwood / 150 to Acme for urgency labels.
- Schedule a 30-min integration sync with Soojin and Alex for Thu 8/5.

Can you confirm dataset delivery ETA and who on your side will own procurement?

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachment: Acme_POC_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: acme-sample-data-schema.json (json)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Suneeta Rao <suneeta@acmetech.io>, Alex Morgan <alex@acmetech.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech

Looping in some technical detail here so expectations are aligned for week 2 spike and acceptance testing.

- Baseline infra: we’ll provision a small dedicated instance pool for the trial (no changes needed on Acme infra for hosted trial beyond whitelist + dataset upload).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 450ms — realistic for 16k sequences with current model family; we’ll run continuous profiling and share token-level cost estimates.
- Urgency classifier: lightweight approach — logistic head on top of summary embedding. Labelling plan OK. If Acme can provide 300 labeled from production distribution that’s ideal; if not we’ll do 150/150 as Vanessa suggested.

Acceptance checklists (technical):
1) Data ingestion verified and validated against acme-sample-data-schema.json.
2) Baseline runs (week 1) show summary precision >= 0.7 on the 1k prompt set.
3) Urgency classifier meets precision/recall thresholds on hold-out.
4) Slack spike implementation completed by EOD week 2 and smoke-tested in staging.

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a kanban board with tasks we own. Vanessa — can you confirm if Marcus should lead the Slack integration tasks?

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Suneeta Rao <suneeta@acmetech.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@acmetech.io>, procurement@acmetech.io
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC scope update & proposed evaluation plan for AcmeTech

All good from our side — we accept the Slack triage as exploratory and agree to include the urgency classifier in the POC matrix with the proposed thresholds.

Dataset ETA: Wed 8/4 EOD (anonymized dump + search logs).
Procurement lead: procurement@acmetech.io will take it from here; expect a short DPA redline.
Integration owner: Alex will own the integration work on Acme side; Marcus can lead on Redwood.

Please go ahead and update the timeline & runbook and schedule the Thu 8/5 integration sync. If the Slack spike shows a clear positive signal we’ll discuss expanding scope after week 3.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

— Suneeta

On Tue, Aug 3, 2026 at 11:45 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Suneeta — noted. I’ve scheduled Thu 8/5 10:00am PT for the integration sync and shared a calendar invite. Marcus will lead implementation tasks on Redwood. I’ll share the runbook link by EOD.
>
> -V
